justification: Both surfaces show right-facing bearded male figures in strict profile with hair and beard rendered as regimented rows of tight curls, and both include a large wing built from stacked registers of overlapping feathers, plus the same convention of covering surfaces with dense incised texture, which is a fairly specific shared repertoire. The scenes differ in content, however: A is a single monumental winged figure with raised arm and fringed garment filling the panel, whereas B is a procession of two smaller nude-torsoed men driving horned rams along a ground line, with animals absent from A entirely.
